title: Lakes End Boat Rentals and Marina
specs: Lake Nantahala is in a high-elevation Appalachian temperate rainforest with rapidly changing weather
UTV tours visit scenic rivers, suspension bridge, waterfalls, Appalachian Trail, and mountain overlooks
Must be at least 21 years old to rent motorized boats and have valid driver's license; 23 years old to operate jet skis
Must be at least 18 years old for non-motorized rentals or have written parental consent if under 18
Valid driver's license required for boat rentals and UTV tours
NASBLA approved boating education required for operators born after Jan 1, 1988 for vessels 10 HP or greater
Passengers of any age allowed on vessels; children under 13 must wear USCG approved life jackets
UTV drivers must be 21 or 18 with legal guardian over 21; minimum age for UTV tour guests is 6 years old
UTV tours may have multiple groups per vehicle; book 4 people for private UTV
includes: All safety equipment (PFDs, fire extinguisher, throw cushion, paddle, noise making device) included with watercraft rentals
Safety equipment (helmets, safety glasses, fire extinguishers, first aid kits, radios) included with UTV tours
gap: Exact prices for boat and jet ski rentals not stated
blurb: Guests rent motorized and non-motorized watercraft to explore Lake Nantahala. Rentals include safety equipment and a full tank of fuel, with fuel costs paid by the renter. Guided UTV tours offer scenic drives through Nantahala National Forest with a guide.
extraNote: 50% deposit required at booking for boat rentals; full payment required for UTV tours · Cancellation for boat rentals: full refund if canceled 3 days prior for hourly/half day, 7 days for full/multi-day; no refund if late or no-show · Cancellation insurance available for both boat rentals and UTV tours · Late return fee for boats: $50 per 15 minutes; no refunds or discounts for early returns · Lakes End Marina may cancel or reschedule rentals due to inclement weather; rescheduling subject to availability · No alcohol or drugs allowed; violation may result in cancellation without refund · Lakes End Marina, 17838 Wayah Rd, Topton, NC
